subject: V3 blocker: patcher cannot apply to claimed current-main product baseline
body: Direct GitHub SOURCE verification against current main db0810e55a411a905f3877cc2a3518881c044daf (product-source identical to V3 base 633c75be; the only intervening commit is protocol/control files) shows V3 apply anchors are not present. app/build.gradle.kts is versionCode=42/versionName=5.0.0-beta1-zfold7, while patch_build requires 44/6.0.0-alpha2-zfold7. Current PanelEngine constructor has no privacyDecision/onCaptureBlocked Gen6-V2 surface seam and creates SnapshotSurface/LiveBlurSurface, while patch_panel requires PublicGlassSurface/PrivateFrostSurface and the newer constructor. ControlSheet and accessibility anchors are likewise not the expected Gen6-V2 shapes. Therefore --self-test PASS does not establish applicability: running V3 apply against authoritative current main will fail before integration. V3 is a layered development delta requiring an unpublished/unintegrated Gen6 V2 + Beta Hotfix substrate, not a root-safe current-main patch. Manager requires either (a) a reproducible, checksum-pinned prerequisite chain proven from current main, or preferably (b) one root-safe composite Gen7 patch/package generated and tested against current main.
